subtitle: Journey of the Skyboard
promotionalText: EARLY ALPHA — ride Autumn's skyboard from Earth's surface to the far side of the Milky Way. New worlds and features land often; optional support keeps them coming.
description:
DART Meadow: Journey of the Skyboard is an open-ended space exploration game, now in EARLY ALPHA development.

Ride with Autumn, a skyboard pilot, through a to-scale solar system and out across the Milky Way. Fly from orbit down through the atmosphere, pick a landing spot on a spinning 3D globe of each world, then step off the board and walk procedurally generated terrain, with Earth's real relief, coastlines and water.

EXPLORE
• A to-scale solar system and a Milky Way galaxy you can actually fly across
• Land on planets and moons using the 3D landing globe, with day and night lighting
• Walk procedural marching-cubes terrain, or let walk-map autopilot carry you
• Atmospheric flight with Mach effects, from deep space to treetop height

PLAY TOGETHER
• Multiplayer: see other pilots in the world, add friends and chat
• Share journal markers so friends can fly to the places you found
• Spectator free-fly camera and photo mode with a HUD toggle for clean shots

MAKE IT YOURS
• A flight journal with markers, quick travel and multiple save slots
• HUD themes, an in-game music player with the DART Meadow soundtrack, and graphics presets for your device
• Sign in with Apple or GitHub to keep your progress, or play as a guest

EARLY ALPHA
DART Meadow is built independently and is still early in development. Expect rough edges, missing features and frequent updates. Your feedback shapes what comes next.

The game is free. Optional in-app purchases (a one-time Support Early Alpha purchase and a Monthly Alpha Supporter subscription) directly fund development. They unlock no content. The subscription renews monthly until you cancel it in Settings ▸ Apple Account ▸ Subscriptions.

reviewNotes: No account is required: tap Continue as Guest (or use Sign in with Apple). From the main menu tap Launch to fly. The game is in early alpha. The optional support purchases are behind the ❤ button on the main menu; they unlock no content.
